title: OrganizerFormAssetsStoragePath
description: Private respondent-uploaded form assets stored at organizerForms/{formId}/{draftId}/{assetId}. Upload and download access is granted only through short-lived backend-signed policies and URLs.
x-storage-read: server-signed URL only (direct client reads denied)
x-storage-write: server-signed POST policy only (direct client writes denied)

formId.description: Organizer form document id; path segment.

draftId.description: Respondent draft document id; path segment.

assetId.description: Deterministic upload-intent asset id; path segment.
